title: Riverside Municipal Campground

services.name: Riverside Municipal Campground
services.desc: You cannot make a reservation within 3 days of your expected arrival. If you are looking to stay within this 3 day window, please make your way down to the campground on the date you are looking to stay. Campsites will then be assigned on a first come, first served basis. Check-in time is 1PM. Check-out time is 11AM. No early check-ins or late check-outs. Full payment of camping fees is required to secure a reservation. Reservation holders must be at least 19 years of age and are responsible for the actions of all party members. Riverside Municipal Campground will not be responsible for allocating multiple sites to those in your group, that will be the responsibility of the group

explain.meaning: A standard RV power connection, enough for one air conditioner.
